result.summary: Analysis revealed two visual layout issues concerning interface overlap and component consistency.

issues.description: The system navigation gesture bar overlaps the bottom menu icons, obscuring the search and bookmark buttons.
issues.suggestion: Adjust bottom padding to ensure the navigation bar does not intersect with app icons.

issues.description: Delivery time badges in the 'Fastest near you' section have inconsistent horizontal alignment across different cards.
issues.suggestion: Apply a uniform alignment rule for status badges within the card component.
